# The Quillmark

> The Quillmark is the front page of the samcbarth.com network: housing, tools and tech, gaming, streaming, home repair and deals news in one place, with every story linked to its source.

Hub of the samcbarth.com network. Section headlines link to the network site that published them; stories under /story/ are written here and cite primary sources.

## Sections
- [Real Estate](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/real-estate/): Mortgage rates, home sales, rents and investing news, with a Texas and Oklahoma lens. Source site: https://realestate.samcbarth.com/
- [Tools and Tech](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/tools-tech/): Software, AI and web tools news for marketers, developers and small business owners. Source site: https://tools.samcbarth.com/
- [Gaming](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/gaming/): Release dates, industry moves and platform news from the games business. Source site: https://games.samcbarth.com/
- [Streaming](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/streaming/): Prices, bundles, devices and what changes for subscribers. Source site: https://streaming.samcbarth.com/
- [Home](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/home/): Recalls, permits, codes and costs that affect DIY home repair. Source site: https://homerepair.samcbarth.com/
- [Deals](https://news.samcbarth.com/section/deals/): Retail seasons, sale events and shopping data, without the countdown clocks. Source site: https://deals.samcbarth.com/

## Hub stories
- [Skydance plans a combined Paramount+ and HBO Max streamer for early 2027](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/skydance-plans-paramount-hbo-max-streamer/): The company told shareholders the merged service would come at one price. It did not give the price.
- [Denver launches an AI tool that pre-checks building permit applications](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/denver-launches-ai-permit-intake-check/): StartSmart flags missing items before an application goes to city staff. Staff still make the final call.
- [OpenAI agrees to acquire Pierre, maker of Code Storage, to build out Codex](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/openai-to-acquire-pierre-code-storage/): Pierre's open-source developer libraries will stay open source, and current Code Storage customers can keep using it after the deal closes.
- [Grand Theft Auto VI is 10 days out: what to know about the Nov. 19 launch](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/gta-vi-launch-date-november-19/): Rockstar's release date has held since it moved from May, making it the biggest game launch of the holiday season.
- [Mortgage rates dip to 7.18% in Freddie Mac's Nov. 5 survey](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/mortgage-rates-dip-to-7-18-percent/): The 30-year fixed average fell for a third straight week, but it is still almost a full point above where it sat a year ago.
- [Existing-home sales rose 1.5% in September as inventory climbed](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/existing-home-sales-rise-in-september/): NAR counted a 3.99 million annual sales pace, with the median price up 1.3% from a year earlier to $417,500.
- [NRF forecasts 2026 holiday sales will top $1 trillion](https://news.samcbarth.com/story/nrf-forecasts-holiday-sales-above-1-trillion/): The retail trade group expects November and December sales to grow 4.2% over 2025, with up to 375,000 seasonal hires.
